Only download the model you choose. After verification, tap Use as main model; Mika tests it before switching. This also sets the light model to local and turns off the online vision model. You can change these choices later.

Text models use text, screen controls and OCR, not image understanding. Smaller models use fewer resources; complex task quality and speed need testing on your phone. Local inference needs no developer options, but operating apps needs separate setup.
